description: The currency list read by contract version 2 (Step 0, blueprint 42 A). Every amount in an event is an integer in the currency's minor unit; the number of decimals here says how a minor amount is shown (RWF 1500 = RWF 1,500; USD 1500 = USD 15.00). ISO 4217 codes. Adding a currency is adding a line here; no code change. A country pack may only name a currency that is in this list.
